ideas.pitch: A hyper-addictive tap-to-earn social mini-game designed to hook players on the Tryb Social App and drive viral daily active user counts.
ideas.problem_statement: Build a bite-sized, fun, and interactive web mini-game directly on the Tryb Social App, get real players hooked over the weekend, and battle it out on the live DAU leaderboard to win cash prizes!
ideas.title: TrybTap: Social Clicker Battle
ideas.why_it_could_win: Since the 1st place winner is decided strictly by Average DAU over the weekend, a mechanic featuring shareable referral links for bonus taps directly targets the primary judging metric.

ideas.pitch: An endless runner minigame featuring custom community avatars where players compete for high scores and share screenshots to social feeds.
ideas.problem_statement: Build a bite-sized, fun, and interactive web mini-game directly on the Tryb Social App, get real players hooked over the weekend, and battle it out on the live DAU leaderboard to win cash prizes!
ideas.title: MemeRunner: Endless Viral Jumper
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines a frictionless web minigame architecture with built-in social sharing hooks, ensuring high retention and returning players to clear the 10 DAU daily qualifying rule.

ideas.pitch: A fast-paced trivia minigame where users answer rapid-fire questions about pop culture and tech to climb the live daily leaderboard.
ideas.problem_statement: Build a bite-sized, fun, and interactive web mini-game directly on the Tryb Social App, get real players hooked over the weekend, and battle it out on the live DAU leaderboard to win cash prizes!
ideas.title: TrybTrivia: Real-Time Multiplayer Quiz Rush
ideas.why_it_could_win: Trivia naturally drives high return rates because players want to check their rank changes, securing the Daily Active User counts needed for the ₹22,500 prize pool.

ideas.pitch: A micro-game where players drop pins on a map based on nostalgic street views, optimized for lightning-fast mobile browser sessions.

ideas.title: ChronoGuessr: Quick Location Challenge
ideas.why_it_could_win: Short 30-second round loops mean players can easily play multiple times a day during breaks, directly maximizing the Average DAU metric across Friday, Saturday, and Sunday.

ideas.title: StackOverflow: Tower Building Arcade
ideas.why_it_could_win: Simple physics-based puzzle games have instant retry loops, ensuring players return repeatedly over the weekend window to satisfy the strict 10 DAU daily cutoff rule.
